title: Asked about pianists, then 'Dirty Baby' song
summary: The interviewer asks about several musicians and he says no; he then sings the 'Dirty Baby' lyric, followed by filler.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: You know any Matt Waller students, Dink? No. Amos Behavin? No. Tony Haxington.

Dirty Baby, Dirty Baby, won't you let me hold you in the cream of our love? I've been there all the while. And I'd love to have a baby, and it might as well be you. Dirty Baby, come mine, come mine. Dirty Baby, Dirty Baby. The End
